sentence: This project studies how RNA alternative splicing of a transcription factor changes glioma cells and their response to therapy.
This project builds a pooled CRISPR screening platform that reads genetic perturbations and protein markers in single cells.
This project tests whether a cognitive training program on a mobile app can improve emotion regulation in people with psychotic disorders.
This project studies how a lysosome storage disease causes severe defects in the heart and bone development of children.
This project uses machine learning with whole genome sequencing of plasma to detect circulating tumor DNA in melanoma and non-small cell lung cancer.
This project provides a veterinary diagnostic laboratory with an automated system that checks nucleic acid quality for molecular diagnostics.
This project tries to find out how and why different physicians manage patients with sepsis in different ways.
This project looks for alternative splicing events caused by mutation in cancer and the neoantigens that arise from them, using mass spectrometry data.
This project studies how hormones change the way the auditory system works during development and reproduction.
This project offers small animal imaging that allows non-invasive assessment of tumor development and response to therapy.
This project focuses on the genetic analysis of non-communicable diseases and how genetics and the microbiome interact with exposures.
This project provides tissue and blood sampling, processing, and annotation for other projects.
This project explores how secreted proteases help control how Staphylococcus aureus causes disease.
This project studies the structure of interactions between HIV-1 protein and nucleic acid.
This project uses brain imaging and neuronal recording to find out how brain networks for social behavior work and become disrupted in autism.
This project builds a research center to improve understanding of common health conditions in a rural environment.
This project studies how chemoradiation causes evolution of tumor subpopulations in rectal cancer and looks for ways to target them.
This project studies neural mechanisms in the prefrontal cortex that may cause cognitive impairment when daily rhythms are disrupted.
This project works with Tribal communities to improve cancer screening and reduce the cancer burden.
This project studies how the neuromodulator adenosine regulates signaling in intrinsically photosensitive retinal ganglion cells.
